propositions: 12 modules are currently grandfathered over the 800 LOC soft cap via an allowlist escape hatch that also permits ceiling bumps, allowing over-cap modules to persist and grow.

The module-size allowlist and ceilings mechanism must be completely removed, with each grandfathered module split along a logical call-graph seam and landed as individual changes before the escape hatch is deleted.

After all 12 module splits are merged, the allowlist/ceilings files, the sync contract test, and the allowlist branch in the shell gate must be deleted, replacing them with an absolute 800 LOC enforcement with no exemptions.
A hard gate must be added to prevent the module-size limit itself from being changed through the normal contribution process; only admin manual override is permitted.
